newsitem.title: CROATIA: Zagrebacka in 400mln mark syndicate loan.
newsitem.headline: Zagrebacka in 400mln mark syndicate loan.

text.p: Zagrebacka Banka said on Wednesday it had closed a deal with a syndicate of 51 foreign banks for a three-year loan worth 400 million German marks.
"The loan is priced at 0.5 over Libor, which is the lowest margin so far achieved by a Croatian borrower, including the government," a senior bank source told Reuters.
The deal, struck last week, will be signed in London on June 12. The funds will be used for "general purposes", including funding the bank's normal credit activities in Croatia, the source said.
The syndicate's joint arrangers were Barclays Bank , Chase Investment Bank , The Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank and Dresdner Bank , with 11 other international banks acting as co-arrangers.
Zagrebacka had originally sought to raise 300 million marks, but some 51 banks joined the syndicate, offering more than 700 million.

The loan substituted a planned Eurobond issue which was abandoned after the bank secured long and short term investment grade ratings from two leading agencies earlier this year. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
